Ammonia Leak in Tamil Nadu Kills Multiple Workers, Prompts Investigations

An ammonia gas leak at a seafood processing unit in Tiruvallur, Tamil Nadu, has resulted in multiple fatalities and left dozens hospitalized. The incident has prompted investigations into the cause and the conditions of affected workers, including migrant laborers. Concerns have also been raised regarding the transportation of relief supplies for those impacted.
